## Overview

`typed-factorio` publishes TypeScript type definitions for the Factorio modding
Lua API, for use with [TypeScriptToLua](https://typescripttolua.github.io/).

A Factorio mod loads in 3 stages, each a separate Lua context with different
globals: **settings**, **prototype** (aka data stage), and **runtime**. Types
ship per stage (`settings/`, `prototype/`, `runtime/`, plus shared `common/`);
consumers pick stages via `compilerOptions.types`.

## Generated files

`runtime/generated/` and `prototype/generated/` (TypescriptToLua types) are generated by `generator/`
(node typescript code), from Factorio's API JSON (`generator/input/*-api-<version>.json`),
Never hand-edit; change the generator or the manual definitions.

`npm run generate` (`generate-no-format` to iterate faster) to build; the
output is committed (CI fails if committed output differs from a fresh generate).

Changes/addition to the JSON is hand-authored in
`generator/input/manual-defs-{runtime,prototype}.ts`, which can also
override/augment generated types via JSDoc tags (e.g. `@omit`, `@addTo`; see
`generator/ManualDefinitions.ts`, `generator/added-types.ts`).

Each stage's generator (`generator/{runtime,prototype}/index.ts`) runs a
`preprocess*` pass over all categories before any `generate*` pass, so
cross-references resolve.

## Verifying

`npm run check` (lint + format + type-check) before considering changes done.
There is no unit-test runner; `test/test.ts` is a type-level test checked by
`type-check`.

The README documents consumer-facing type conventions; preserve them, and update
the README if a generator change alters them.
